config.header: NetCraft.TPGA configuration file. System-generated. Restart after edit. Out-of-range fields reset to default.
config.logDirectory: Log directory. Relative to program working directory.
config.database: Database. sqlite:filepath or other prefix connection string postgres:Host=...
config.playerDatabase: Player database. Isolated from main DB. Stores game accounts, tokens, profiles, server joins.
config.certificatePath: HTTPS/WSS certificate path. Empty to auto-generate self-signed.
config.certificatePassword: Certificate password. PFX private key protection. Random on auto-generate.
config.serverName: Server name. Shown in metadata and logs.
config.skinDomains: Skin domains whitelist. Comma-separated. Client loads textures from these.
config.oauthProviders: OAuth providers list. Configured count = button count. Empty disables. type=github preset, type=generic fills endpoints.
config.portOutOfRange: Port out of range, reset to default
cert.passwordGenerated: Certificate password empty, random generated and written back
admin.bootstrap: Admin table empty, default admin/admin created, change on first login
